newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in sluggish trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended unchanged against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday due to a lack of trading interest, but dealers expected the local unit to continue its slowly depreciating trend next week.
The currency traded in an extremely narrow T$27.884-889 range throughout the shortened Saturday session. It finished at T$27.888 against one U.S. dollar, unchanged from Friday.
Turnover through dealers was US$47.5 million.
"It is a very quiet weekend, nothing worth mentioning," said one dealer.
Dealers said persistent quarter-end greenback demand, foreign fund outflows and a strong U.S. dollar overseas would further weaken the Taiwan dollar next week.
However, the central bank was expected to continue actions to blunt any volatile depreciation.
A narrow range of T$27.85-90 was seen for next week.
